detail.longDescription: I’m Good For Nothing. I think my ability to deal with life's curve balls comes from doing nothing. These are moments of inactivity, hours of them sometimes, spent having minimal thought and movement. I day dream, build conversations that don't happen, sing for myself or even spend hours staring at the wall. I don't think humans are built for modern productivity where you have to be doing something all the time chasing metrics.
